supersedes_only: Earlier deterministic-name suggestion for removal quarantine; publication scratch derivation remains separate.
decision: Keep existing trusted native remover with fresh cryptographic UUID not exposed before rename. Do not add a prepared public quarantine-name variant using overwriting POSIX rename.
Freeze exact same-directory grammar, at most one quarantine, fixed native rename/recheck/owned-unlink or no-replace restore, parent fsync and uncertainty preservation in explicit removal recipe.
The logical removal target remains exact and identity-bound; only native code chooses the transient quarantine. No caller destination or generic filesystem grant.

Describe freshness/unexposure honestly, not as an atomic no-replace destination guarantee. An OS no-replace primitive would be required for preselected/exposed destinations or a stronger collision guarantee.

Crash after rename may leave an unknown opaque quarantine. Preserve it and fail closed; a new lease cannot reconstruct that old quarantine from its nonce/pid, and cannot infer ownership from name or contents.
Publication scratch may still derive from existing authenticated lease fields and use exclusive creation/no-replace link. Its deterministic naming does not transfer to rename quarantine.
counterexamples: Known/precreated prepared quarantine must never be accepted as an overwrite destination.
Foreign source entry swapped before rename is restored without replacement or preserved with uncertainty.
Unknown crash quarantine remains untouched and blocks dependent unsafe continuation.
Extra scratch destinations supplied by caller are rejected.
qualification: Independent design judgment from existing remover/source/schema inspection; no prepared-remover or dead-lease runtime activation claimed.
